moworks.notes: Success badge (r 40) scales 0 → 1 with overshoot: recipe 0 → 1.15 at 300 ms → 1.0 at 450 ms (back.out, CSS bezier .34,1.56,.64,1 — that bezier alone peaks at ~1.10 at 57 % of the time); small demo 500 ms on that bezier; its check mark draws in 350 ms power2.out from 250 ms. Exit: shrink 300 ms. Rule: overshoot 10–20 %. Params: duration (0.45 s) · peak (1.15) · ease (back.out) · check: dấu tích (bật/tắt). The recipe: 0 → 1.15 at 0.3 s → 1 at 0.45 s (back.out). Rule: overshoot 10–20 %.
